objective: To process the Kanban Crossdock Master file uploaded from the Cross Dock Part Master screen (Kanban Crossdock Master tab): from the [Validate file] button of the Upload Excel modal until the data is saved to TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE.
In case any error occurs, nothing is saved to the master. The error is recorded in the upload log and a result report is created.

steps.text: If any row has an error, reject the whole file. Nothing is saved to the master and the errors are recorded in the upload log.
If all rows are valid, save to master table TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE (see 4.3).
children: Add: register the new part as Candidate.
Edit: update the changed values, including status Active <-> Inactive. A row with no change is skipped.

Call SP_STG_WRITE per changed value: Kanban EDIT of an Active part (OPERATION_TYPE 1 / 2 / 3); Active -> Inactive: the mapping of the period is deleted, Export DELETE (0) per destination, GTOPAS DELETE and the Kanban header (refer XD01 5.24). A row without change writes nothing.

steps: Create the result report and record the result (completed or rejected) in the upload log. The Kanban Crossdock Master screen shows the result to the user. Exit.

func_desc.text: This batch starts when the user clicks [Validate file] in the Upload Excel modal of the Kanban Crossdock Master screen. It checks the uploaded file and, if everything is valid, saves the data to TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE. If not, the upload is rejected and recorded in the upload log.

items: Only sheet "Upload" of the file is read. Parts that are not in the sheet are not changed.
One run saves all rows or none (all-or-nothing).
Part Name is retrieved from TB_M_PART_MASTER. Total Pcs/Day is calculated as Pcs/Case x Max Case/Day. Both are saved.
File extension is .xlsx.
File size is 5 MB or less.
Sheet Upload has 1 to 5,000 data rows.
Sheet "Upload" exists. Other sheets are ignored.
Header has the 7 template columns (see Appendix), found by column name (case and leading / trailing spaces ignored). Extra columns are ignored.

func_desc.text: Every row is checked and all errors are collected, so the user can correct the file once.

items: If any row is rejected, nothing is saved to TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE. The upload status and the error of every row are recorded in the upload log (Log).

If all rows are valid, the data is saved to TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE: flag A inserts a new part (status Candidate), flag E updates the changed values, including status Active <-> Inactive. Rows with no change are skipped.
The status of a Candidate part is changed only in the Edit part data modal on the screen, not by upload.
Every inserted or changed part gets a history record per changed field in TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE (event ADD / EDIT, source UPLOAD, UPLOAD_ID of this run; refer Appendix).
Every changed value of an Active part goes to the staging tables through SP_STG_WRITE (SOURCE UPLOAD, UPLOAD_ID); the part is sent by the next [Sync]. A new (Candidate) part gets no staging row.
A result report (.xlsx) is created for both cases.

rows: Flag A: Part No is not yet in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE. Flag E: it already is.
Part No appears only once in the file.
Min MAD is a whole number, 0 or more, and Pcs/Case and Max Case/Day are whole numbers greater than 0; all three are required on every row.

Status: flag A must be blank (a new part is always Candidate). Flag E: a Candidate part must stay Candidate (blank or Candidate); an Active part may be changed to Inactive and an Inactive part to Active; no part can be changed to Candidate.

Period is required for flag A and must be the ongoing period or the next period (YYYYMM). The part takes effect from it; when the ongoing period is given after day D, the row is also written for the next period.
Flag E: Period must be the ongoing period (the period of the export). A part registered for the next period cannot be changed until its period becomes the ongoing period.

Flag E: Max Case/Day is not below the total Case/Day already mapped per destination in the ongoing calculation period of Export Crossdock Master (TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST) (e.g. mapped 100, new Max Case/Day 80 is rejected). The user must first reduce the mapping in the Export Crossdock Master sub-menu, then lower Max Case/Day in Kanban Crossdock Master.

items: Kanban Crossdock Master (former Part List) has a period like the Export Crossdock Master: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE is kept per PART_NO + PERIOD (Status, Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day of that month).
The upload changes the rows of the ongoing period only; Next (made by XD05) and past periods are not changed.

Max Case/Day of a period may not be below the mapped total of that period (message 14): to lower it, D/S first reduces the destinations on the Export Crossdock Master, then changes Max Case/Day on the Kanban Crossdock Master.
Every save calls the stored procedure SP_STG_WRITE once per changed value, in the same transaction and after the master tables are updated. A save without a changed value writes nothing.

Kanban (TB_H_STG_APPOLE_KANBAN): a change of Pcs/Case or Max Case/Day of an Active part writes a row with the values after the change (ACTION EDIT); Candidate -> Active and a part of a new period write ACTION ADD. OPERATION_TYPE compares the new Max with the last Max sent to AP POLE (same period, else the latest earlier period): 1 = Max down, 2 = Max up, 3 = Max same, 4 = never sent.

Export (TB_H_STG_APPOLE_EXPORT): one row per added (ADD), changed (EDIT) or removed (DELETE, Max Shipping Box (RCS) 0) destination + order type. Active -> Inactive writes DELETE (0) for every destination of the part.

GTOPAS (TB_H_STG_GTOPAS): a row only when the destination appears or disappears for the part (any order type) and GTOPAS does not have that state yet. A Case/Day change or an order type change of a destination that stays writes no GTOPAS row.

Header: an Export change of a part + period without an unsent Kanban row writes the Kanban header with ACTION KEEP and OPERATION_TYPE 5 (current Kanban values, not uploaded). So every part of a run has one Kanban row that sets its upload order.

Superseded: a new row of a key marks the older unsent row of the same key SYNC_STATUS 2. A value set back to the value already sent for the period gets SYNC_STATUS 2 too (nothing to send). Keys: Kanban PERIOD + PART_NO; Export PERIOD + NSP_PART_NO + DEST_CODE + ORDER_TYPE; GTOPAS PERIOD + P_NO + DESTINATION_CODE.
SOURCE UPLOAD, UPLOAD_ID of the upload. The part is sent by the next [Sync] (refer XD01 5.24).

Rules and simulation: deliverables/function_list_v2/erd/proposal_staging_sync (Proposal_Tables_Staging_Per_Target.xlsx, simulation/Staging_Header_Order.html, simulation/Staging_Per_Target_Full_Flow_Simulation.xlsx).
